source_basis: For Task 1 ... For Task 2 ... For Task 3
interpretation: The abstract is a numbered list of tasks, one sentence each. No framing paragraph.
applicability: Reusable when the prompt has numbered tasks.

source_basis: with the probability of 62.8% and p-value smaller than 0.001
interpretation: Both the effect size and the p-value in the same clause.
counterevidence: The probability is a test quantity, not a plain proportion.

source_basis: there is no strong evidence (p-value > 0.1)
interpretation: A negative result reported with the threshold, not softened.

source_basis: it is necessary to quantify music evolution
interpretation: Closes background by declaring quantification necessary. A stock move, but placed after a real quotation.

source_basis: The key to this problem is to define
interpretation: Each restated task ends by naming its crux.
counterevidence: Seven in a row is repetitive.

source_basis: This assumption is a reasonable simplification to make breakpoint identification possible
interpretation: A strong assumption defended as the price of a computation.
counterevidence: Reasonable is doing a lot of work.

source_basis: A naive idea to measure the local importance
interpretation: The first metric is labeled naive before the better one arrives. Sets up the improvement.
counterevidence: Naive can sound dismissive of a metric still used.

source_basis: In the cases above, we align greater weight
interpretation: Two concrete cases, then the weighting rule. L2 verb choice, clear logic.

source_basis: However, Howlin' Wolf has fewer followers ... because his followers are more famous
interpretation: One named exception that justifies the whole weighted score.

source_basis: As it conflicts with common sense, we believe most lyrics remained undetected
interpretation: A field dropped for contradicting the author's knowledge of the world, not for a statistical reason.

source_basis: this simple measure doesn't need any assumption on data and is easy to calculate
interpretation: Chooses the crude measure and names the assumption it avoids.

source_basis: nearly three out of ten artists aren't affected by their so-called influencers
interpretation: A percentage turned into a count and the keyword put in scare quotes.
counterevidence: The threshold behind it is arbitrary.

source_basis: 5603 nodes, 42770 edges, three centralities summed with equal weight
interpretation: A large directed graph reduced to one number per node.

source_basis: Seven principal components kept at just over 80 percent variance
interpretation: Dimension cut reported with the retained share.

source_basis: Hill climbing with random restarts, 500 bootstrap averages
interpretation: An intractable search replaced by a heuristic plus averaging.
applicability: Say both the shortcut and the stabilizer.

source_basis: Dynamic programming for breaks, cost quadratic and independent of the count
interpretation: The complexity claim is the reason for the algorithm.
counterevidence: BIC penalty is one of several.

source_basis: Strong influence without similarity, flagged for later
interpretation: A result that contradicts the model is marked rather than explained away.

source_basis: All four hypotheses accepted, so the multiple-testing risk is moot
interpretation: A caveat raised and then shown not to bind.

source_basis: Mann-Whitney, probability 0.628, p under 0.001
interpretation: Nonparametric test chosen because normality fails.
applicability: Match the test to the distribution.

source_basis: Trim from 0.05n to 0.20n; the 1950 break survives past 0.10n
interpretation: A one-parameter sensitivity table with the chosen value inside the stable range.

source_basis: Explicit flag removed: 3647 of 98430 tracks
interpretation: Cleaning decision with the count that motivated it.
counterevidence: The flag might be real for that subset.

source_basis: Continuous variables standardized before PCA
interpretation: Scaling stated before the decomposition.

source_basis: Three assumptions, each with a justification line
interpretation: Assumption and defense in the same bullet.
counterevidence: The linear-trend one is the load-bearing one.

source_basis: Errors assumed white noise, later conceded to be dependent
interpretation: The paper corrects itself in the weaknesses.
applicability: Point forward when an assumption will be walked back.
counterevidence: The correction changes nothing in the results.

source_basis: Four characteristics break near 1950, matching the genre shift
interpretation: Two independent readings agree.

source_basis: Elvis Presley and Cliff Richard named as revolutionaries
interpretation: A network core translated into names.

source_basis: Three periods tied to the Depression, the war, and the late 1990s
interpretation: Statistical breaks given historical labels.

source_basis: A 3D drawing of the full influence network
interpretation: The whole graph shown once, then ten small radial subnetworks.

source_basis: Genre similarity heatmap beside the influence heatmap
interpretation: The two relations that the text contrasts are drawn the same way.

source_basis: Change-point plot with the fitted segments drawn through the series
interpretation: The breaks are visible as corners in the fitted line.

source_basis: A letter to the society rather than to a coach
interpretation: The required communication is addressed to the organization named in the prompt.
applicability: Match the addressee to the prompt.

source_basis: The weakness names the realistic error process the model cannot handle
interpretation: A limitation stated as a technical alternative, not an apology.
